instruction:
First, open the Navigation pane to check whether the page numbers correspond correctly, and correct any incorrect page numbers: begin page numbering with the Abstract section; use uppercase Roman numerals for the Abstract and table of contents pages, and Arabic numerals for the main body.
Second, delete the last page of the document.
Third, create a List of Tables from all tables in the document and place it on the document's List of Tables page.
Fourth, adjust the positions and sizes of the tables: place a table on the same page as the text whenever they can fit on one page; if they cannot fit on one page, place the table on a separate page whenever possible.

dim1: The deliverable is a Microsoft Word file in an accepted .docx format, and the file can be opened normally.
dim2: +3: The entire “Author Biography” page has been deleted from the document.
+3: The document uses section-based page numbering: no page numbers are added to the cover page, Thesis Defense Committee Approval Form, or Acknowledgments page before the Abstract page.

+3: From the page containing “Abstract” through the page containing the List of Tables, footer page numbers use uppercase Roman numerals, and the page-number sequence increases consecutively as I, II, III, IV…

+3: Starting from the page containing “Chapter One Introduction,” the footer page number changes to the Arabic numeral 1; main-body page numbering starts on the “Chapter One Introduction” page and increases consecutively as 1, 2, 3, 4… through the end of “References.”
+5: The table of contents in the document is an automatically updating table of contents, and clicking a corresponding entry navigates to its location.
+1: The table of contents does not contain an “Acknowledgments” entry.

+5: In the table of contents, the page number corresponding to “Abstract” is the uppercase Roman numeral I, the page number corresponding to the English abstract “Abstract” is the uppercase Roman numeral II, the page number corresponding to the Table of Contents page is the uppercase Roman numeral IV, the page number corresponding to the List of Tables is VI, and the page number corresponding to the List of Figures is VII.
+3: On the “List of Tables” page, the List of Tables appears before the “List of Figures” page.
+3: Table 3-1 is entirely on the same page and is not split across pages.
+3: Table 4-1 is entirely on the same page and is not split across pages.
-3: There is more than one blank line above or below Table 3-1.
-3: The table of contents content is not in PMingLiU-ExtB, Chinese font size No. 4.

-3: The table of contents content uses paragraph formatting with a first-line indent of two characters, 1.5 line spacing, and justified alignment, and second-level heading text has a Before text indent of two characters.
-3: There is more than one blank line above or below the table on the page containing Table 4-1.

-3: A university emblem image does not appear at the very top of the cover page, or the university emblem image does not meet the following requirements: dimensions of 5.08 × 15.23 cm, Layout Options set to In Line with Text, and justified alignment.
-1: The font formatting of “Master's Degree Thesis” on the cover page does not meet the requirements of SimSun, size 28, and bold.
-1: The paragraph formatting of “Master's Degree Thesis” on the cover page does not meet the requirements of 1.5 line spacing, a Before text indent of two characters, and centered alignment.
-1: The font formatting of the Acknowledgments page title does not meet the requirements of SimSun, Chinese font size No. 2, and bold.
-1: The paragraph formatting of the content on the Chinese Abstract page does not meet the requirements of a first-line indent of two characters, 1.5 line spacing, and justified alignment.
-1: The font formatting of the content on the English Abstract page does not meet the requirements of Times New Roman, Chinese font size No. 4.
-1: The paragraph formatting of the content on the English Abstract page does not meet the requirements of a first-line indent of two characters, 1.5 line spacing, and justified alignment.
-3: The page-number formatting does not meet the requirements of centered alignment and a footer distance from bottom of 1.27 cm.
-3: The header formatting does not meet the requirements of left alignment and a header distance from top of 1.40 cm.
-3: The font formatting of second-level headings does not meet the requirements of PMingLiU-ExtB, Chinese font size Small No. 2, and bold.
-3: The paragraph formatting of second-level headings does not meet the requirements of justified alignment and single line spacing.
-3: The main-body font formatting does not meet the requirements of PMingLiU-ExtB, Chinese font size No. 4.
-3: The main-body paragraph formatting does not meet the requirements of left alignment, a first-line indent of two characters, 1.5 line spacing, 0 lines before, and 10 pt after.

-3: The figure caption formatting does not meet the following requirements: positioned below the image, centered alignment, 1.5 line spacing, 0 lines before, 10 pt after, and a first-line indent of two characters.
-3: The figure caption format does not match “Figure 1-1.”

-3: The figure caption font formatting does not meet the following requirements: Chinese text in PMingLiU-ExtB, Chinese font size No. 4; English text or Arabic numerals in Noto Serif CJK TC, Chinese font size No. 4.

-3: The table caption formatting does not meet the following requirements: positioned above the table, centered alignment, 1.5 line spacing, 0 lines before, 10 pt after, and a first-line indent of two characters.

-3: The paragraph formatting of the content on the References page does not meet the requirements of left alignment, a first-line indent of two characters, 1.5 line spacing, 0 lines before, and 10 pt after.
